purpose: Public seller shop with server total/unique + offset pagination and CT-like filters.
auth: Public. sellerUsername required.

params.query: sellerUsername required; game, limit (max 100), offset, q, condition, language, sort.

purpose: List and append typed events in a canonical private conversation, including atomic direct PKN payments.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; conversation membership is enforced server-side.

params.query: action=list|get and peer for one conversation.
params.body: peer plus text, or a positive whole amountPkn and clientToken for payment.

purpose: Proxy pokoin-user-photos from private R2. Chat requires auth (redirects to /auth); listing is public.
auth: chat: Firebase bearer required. listing: public.

params.query: kind, uid, file from path; optional key=user-photos/...

purpose: Create, pay, decline, or cancel PKN requests represented as typed conversation events.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; request parties and transitions are enforced server-side.

params.body: recipientUsername, amountPkn, note, and clientToken for create; requestId for transitions.

purpose: Reconcile the seller's complete CardTrader inventory into Pokoin (import/link/update/remove linked stock only).
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; seller must have CardTrader connected.

params.query: GET returns last sync status; POST runs reconcile.

purpose: Hide CardTrader-linked listings, or wipe the seller's entire inventory across TCGs (confirm required) so Sync can re-import.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; seller uid from token only.

params.body: scope=linked|all; when scope=all, confirm must be DELETE ALL LISTINGS

purpose: Signed-in seller's CardTrader 1-Day Ready inventory as dashboard assets (never Pokoin listings).
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

purpose: Stored daily collection value: wallet on the days it moved, plus the homepage minimum of 1-Day Ready cards summed once per UTC day.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

purpose: Signed-in recently seen public card ids, scoped by game at storage/query. Writer is the nezopt marketplace primary. Tile JSON is not stored.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

params.query: game required (pokemon|one_piece|riftbound) unless satellite Host / x-pokoin-game supplies it.
params.body: POST { game, cardId } records one view; PUT { game, cardIds } replaces that game list. Cards must exist in the game catalog.

purpose: Poko market intelligence: read-only card resolution, sold-market quotes, liquidity, artist collection quotes, snapshot. One shared tool surface for every Poko channel.
auth: Required service bearer token: POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN, or POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN (same secret, already in the Pi container env). Server-to-server only; browsers never receive it.

params.body: { tool: resolve_card|card_quote|card_ocr|card_liquidity|collection_quote|suggest_cards|market_snapshot|top_movers, params } with tool-specific fields (query, cardId, condition, language, artist, subject, excludeCardId, limit, days, direction).

purpose: Authenticated personal marketplace snapshot for Poko intent: desk, recents, watchlist, cart, inventory, collection. Firebase users sync browser cart/watchlist; Hermes service token loads by firebaseUid for linked Telegram/Discord.
auth: Firebase bearer (user) or POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN / POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN (service + firebaseUid).

params.body: { action: get|sync, watchlistIds?, cart?, desk?, firebaseUid? }

purpose: Website Poko assistant chat (Messages + dock). Firebase-authed Hermes proxy; persists transcript to Firestore poko_conversations/{uid}/events for cross-device sync. No local FAQ or market-tool fallback.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token. Browser never receives the Hermes service token.

params.body: { message, cards?: [{ cardId, name, setName, condition, language }], images?: string[], sessionId?, pageContext? } (POST)

purpose: Seller ship-from country (ISO-2) and Stripe Connect readiness.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Encrypted buyer shipping addresses; countryCode stays queryable outside ciphertext.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; owner only.

params.query: id for PUT/DELETE; reveal=1 to decrypt for owner

purpose: Per-seller shipment quotes from seeded rate tables. Fail closed when route missing.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Live Packlink carriers plus seeded letter rates for a seller→buyer lane. Cart/shipping preview.
auth: Public read.

params.query: fromCountry, toCountry, cards; optional fromZip, toZip

purpose: Stripe Connect Express onboarding and READY status sync.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Freeze EUR order + encrypted address snapshot, open Stripe Checkout Session.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Link a signed-in Pokoin account to a Telegram user for the Poko assistant: create link code (Firebase user), redeem/status/unlink (service token via Hermes).
auth: create_code: Firebase bearer token. redeem/status/unlink: service bearer token (POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN or POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN).

params.body: { action: create_code|redeem|status|unlink, ... } — create_code takes no params; redeem takes code + telegram { userId, username, displayName }; status/unlink take telegramUserId.

purpose: Associate desk: role (distributor, ambassador, …), campaign window, and live royalty earnings on sales made by Italian sellers to Italian buyers.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; caller email must exist in public.marketplace_associates, else 403.

purpose: Invite & Earn: the caller's invite code, invited collectors and 20 PKN rewards (settled on read), plus Ambassador mission progress and tier. POST action=claim attaches a new account to an inviter.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Users-search supplement: active associates roster matches by display name or email prefix (public name, username, role only).
auth: Public. q (min 2 chars) optional.

purpose: Public Sold on Pokoin rows for a card desk: paid native PKN/EUR orders, no buyer identity.
auth: Public. cardId required.

purpose: Pokoin Flex partner-store directory (public) and Partner app intake/bag/handoff contract (mutations coming_soon).
auth: directory/contract public; intake/bag/receive-hub/handoff/pending will require partner auth when live.

params.body: action plus storeId, parcelQr/bagQr/pickupQr as documented by action=contract.

services: Partner store directory (placeholder until Flex launch)

purpose: Scan a CardTrader seller (username or profile URL) for crazy asks vs facet-perfect sold comps (blueprint + condition + language + reverse/1st/graded).
auth: Required Bearer DEAL_SCAN_TOKEN. Intended for the pokoin-ct-deals Vercel proxy; not a public browser endpoint.

services: CardTrader public user JSON (username → account id)

purpose: Card recognition (YOLO detect + Milo embed) for the website, Scan Connect and the app. nezopt GPU first, Pi CPU fallback.
auth: Public; per-IP limit in the recognition worker.

services: nezopt GPU recognition worker via SSH tunnel 127.0.0.1:18151

purpose: Recognize several photos of one album page at once.
auth: Public; per-IP limit in the recognition worker.

services: nezopt GPU recognition worker via SSH tunnel 127.0.0.1:18151

purpose: Recognition catalogs (game × language) the scanner can switch between.
auth: Public; per-IP limit in the recognition worker.

services: nezopt GPU recognition worker via SSH tunnel 127.0.0.1:18151

purpose: Which recognition workers answer (nezopt GPU, Pi CPU).
auth: Public; per-IP limit in the recognition worker.

services: nezopt GPU recognition worker via SSH tunnel 127.0.0.1:18151

purpose: PowerTools-style pricer for the MyPokoin listings board: per-listing market comps.
auth: Bearer required. Caller's own listings are excluded from the Pokoin cheapest.

params.query: items required: comma list of cardId[:COND:LANG], max 100; excludeSellerUid optional (defaults to the bearer uid).

purpose: Daily TCGplayer aggregate price history with all explicitly mapped products and printing subtypes; USD, no condition-specific inference.
auth: Bearer required.

params.query: cardId required; game context; from/to YYYY-MM-DD optional.

purpose: PowerTools-style pricing strategies + pricer defaults stored on users/{uid}.
auth: Bearer required; strategies belong to the bearer uid.

params.body: POST: {strategy} upserts one strategy (empty id mints one); {pricerSettings} saves the pricer defaults; both allowed.

purpose: CardTrader Zero picking list: the weekly merged paid Zero order (the Thursday shipment) plus hub_pending Zero sales still waiting for the next merge, with MyPokoin locations and an optional Power Tools picking overlay.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; seller must have CardTrader connected (404 cardtrader_not_connected otherwise).

purpose: Power Tools session for the seller: GET status, POST signs in (email+password via Outseta, or a pasted jwt session) and stores only the encrypted session, DELETE forgets it.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; seller uid from token only. Failed password sign-ins are throttled per uid.

params.body: POST: email + password, or session (jwt cookie value).

purpose: Poko Discord LoL bets in real PKN. Linked + opted-in users play with their site balance; unlinked users play with a Discord wallet merged once into the Pokoin account on link (capped per account, bonus never carried twice, wallet closed afterwards). Balance-checked stakes into a per-round escrow, server-computed pari-mutuel settle/refund, one-time 20 PKN bonus (aged Discord accounts only for wallets), ledger entries for every movement. reward_game pays a per-game play reward to admin-allowlisted Discord users (poko_config/game_rewards: discordUserIds, amountPkn, dailyCap), once per game.
auth: Service bearer token only (POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN or POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN). Only Discord users linked via poko-connect and opted in can stake or reveal a balance.

services: Firebase Admin (balances, ledger_entries, poko_bet_rounds, poko_bets_consent, poko_bonus_claims, poko_discord_wallets, poko_discord_wallet_ledger, poko_wallet_merges)

purpose: Daily CardTrader lowest listed asks and separately sourced TCGplayer market quotes for one exact public printing. Never synthetic sales.
auth: Public read-only.

params.query: cardId required; game context; from/to YYYY-MM-DD optional, maximum 10 years.

purpose: Visitor IP country for local eBay and Vinted links. Not the shipping address.
auth: Public. Private, never cached. Vary CF-IPCountry.

purpose: TCGplayer product URL for a Pokoin card id, from pokoin_product_links. 404 when unlinked so the desk can open search.
auth: Public. No-store.

params.query: id (public card id), format=json, optional game

purpose: Signed-in buyer's cart for pokoin.com/cart: cart lines, Saved for later and gift flag, synced across devices with revision-checked saves (409 CART_REV + current cart on a lost race).
auth: Firebase bearer token required. Private, never cached.

purpose: Personal card rails for every buyer (buy again, same-seller parcel, also carried, inspired by browsing, artists, trending, watchlist, recently viewed). Only buyable cards, each with the native offer to add.
auth: Public; an optional Firebase bearer adds the account's cart, Recently Seen, watchlist snapshot and paid orders. Private, never cached.

params.query: cart, recent, watch (card ids), sellers (uids), listings (listing ids), limit (4-30). Pokemon storefront only for now.

purpose: Pokoin News reader comments: list visible comments for an article; signed-in users post comments that wait for moderation.
auth: GET public (signed-in callers also get their own pending comments). POST requires a Firebase bearer token; 5 comments per 10 minutes per user.

purpose: Sync with other platforms: provider list with the seller's safe connection status.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

purpose: Connect (credentials, partner request, or Cardmarket OAuth start) / revoke one platform; registers webhooks and starts the link/import job.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token.

params.body: POST: the provider's declared fields; DELETE: none

purpose: Set the one-time OAuth state cookie and redirect to Cardmarket login.
auth: Public; one-time state from POST /api/platform-integrations/cardmarket.

purpose: Cardmarket widget-app callback: swap the request token for an encrypted access token, then redirect to /profile.
auth: Public; requires the state cookie set by /start.

purpose: Signed order webhooks from a connected platform (Shopify/BinderPOS): exactly-once stock decrement + fan-out.
auth: Public; HMAC of the raw body with the seller's stored secret.

purpose: List / manually link / unlink a listing to a product on another platform, or re-run the link/import job.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; listing must belong to the seller.

params.body: POST { listingId, provider, externalId } or { action: resync, provider }; DELETE { listingId, provider }
